faq.q: How is a titanium pen clip manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium pen clip is manufactured using CNC milling; PVD coating (ISO 27874); Diamond-cut beveling; AFP nano-coating. Each step is critical to achieving the required mechanical properties and dimensional tolerances.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for titanium pen clip?
faq.a: Stainless steel (heavier, less fatigue life), aluminum (lower strength)

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium pen clip?
faq.a: Titanium Pen Clip components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply depending on the application and regulatory requirements.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium pen clip?
faq.a: With proper material selection (Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V) and manufacturing process control (thread rolling, heat treatment), titanium titanium pen clip components exhibit excellent fatigue life and corrosion resistance in service.

faq.q: What surface treatments are available for titanium pen clip?
faq.a: Common surface treatments include Passivation ASTM F86. These enhance corrosion resistance, wear properties, and aesthetic appearance.
